events.title: ATI Q1 Earnings Beat Estimates on Robust Demand, Revenues Miss
events.body: ATI beats Q1 EPS on strong aerospace and defense demand, but revenues miss estimates as pricing and product mix lift profitability.

events.title: ATI Q1 Deep Dive: Margin Expansion and Strong Backlog Drive Upbeat Outlook
events.body: Specialty materials manufacturer ATI (NYSE:ATI) fell short of the market’s revenue expectations in Q1 CY2026, with sales flat year on year at $1.15 billion. Its non-GAAP profit of $1 per share was 13.5% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
